Name: White Coconuts
Author: zombifier
Description:
Are you bothered by how Coconut Jelly and Coconut Wine (+ any modded Coconut artisan goods) are brown? We don't make them from the brown husk, but the white flesh inside!

This mod makes Coconuts considered to be a white item under the hood, and in turn makes Coconut Jelly/Wine/etc. white, like the delicious flesh inside. It does not change the Coconut's texture, and is compatible with any and all retexture mods.

NOTE:[list]
[*]Existing coconut jellies and wines will still be brown. Feel free to sell/eat those. New ones will be white as intended.
[*]Because coconuts are no longer considered brown, they cannot be used for the "orange" dye pot at Emily's place. This is a necessary sacrifice for the greater good.
[/list]
